issues.before: Saving the API key rejected some formats.
issues.cause: A 20–200-character limit and an allowlist of letters/digits/underscore/hyphen rejected dotted or long keys before submission to the server. The user's actual key was not read; the precise trigger in their input was not verified.
issues.fix: Treat the key as an opaque HTTP-header value. Remove surrounding whitespace/one pair of quotes; retain the 4096-character limit and prohibition of internal whitespace/control characters. Preserve DPAPI storage.
issues.verification: 35 tests; HTTP saving, DPAPI restart and browser saving passed with a long dotted dummy key. Actual provider validity was not tested.

issues.before: The checkbox was on the card's left; generic descriptions repeated on every card.
issues.cause: The previous card template used a fixed subtitle and free text.
issues.fix: Checkbox at the far right below the source badge. Percentage in the left column; title and concise topic tags in the center. Fire-safety panel unchanged.
issues.verification: Eight cards with real data; checkbox right/below badge; no overflow. Final EXE screenshot recorded.

issues.before: Local source relevance used a raw keyword score; the user requested a percentage and short reason.
issues.cause: No normalized individual trial conditions or validated physical thresholds.
issues.fix: Separate topicCoverage field: 100 × input topics present in source text / number of input topics. Synonyms count once; equal weights. Topic relevance label and green-to-red color steps; physical similarity remains null.
issues.verification: 3/3=100, 1/3=33; O2 does not match CO2; changing numerical values leaves the topic score unchanged. Critical is reserved for the verified numerical-matching path.

issues.before: Reports were under the application or in separate/nested ZIPs.
issues.cause: Package structure did not meet the user's expectation.
issues.fix: A single version ZIP with sibling SpaceApps1 and Developer Patch directories. Only a short summary under application/Patches; technical documents, old/new code, diffs and index in the sibling directory.
issues.verification: Packaging requires two top-level directories, no nested ZIPs, SHA/CRC checks for every member and equality of tested/delivered EXE hashes.

issues.before: No actual numerical-condition similarity or critical thresholds.
issues.cause: Measurement tables have not been normalized and verified by unit, material, geometry, condition and uncertainty.
issues.fix: This release does not resolve that gap. Topic percentage is not physical correspondence, fire probability or critical classification. Sources discussing the same topics may contain different experimental values.
issues.verification: Tests enforce separation between topicCoverage and similarity. Scientific validation remains open.
